findings.description: Critical: _classify() does not map hvac.exceptions.InvalidRequest (HTTP 400) to AUTHENTICATION_FAILED on rejected AppRole login or BOOTSTRAP_INVALID on expired/consumed wrapping lookup/unwrap, falling through to BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.
findings.resolution: Explicitly handle hvac.exceptions.InvalidRequest in _bootstrap() or _classify(): classify as AUTHENTICATION_FAILED during AppRole login, and as BOOTSTRAP_INVALID during sys/wrapping/lookup and unwrap, complying with contracts/README.md and openbao-event.schema.json.

findings.description: Critical: Adding credential_vendors as a required top-level property in AGENTS_SCHEMA causes load_agents_config() to fail with ValidationError on existing test suite agent-coordinator/tests/test_setup_cloud.py.
findings.resolution: Update agent-coordinator/tests/test_setup_cloud.py to include credential_vendors: [] in CUSTOM_REGISTRY (and expand wp-projection write_allow in work-packages.yaml to include this test file, as done in revision 7 for test_agents_config_isolation.py), or provide default handling in load_agents_config for test configurations.
